answer: Give every agent a bonded identity: to join the marketplace an agent locks a modest stake, like a jade token held in escrow, and earns standing only through completed work attested by peers. A fresh identity starts with zero trust, so spawning a thousand copies buys nothing, since each copy must separately lock funds and build its own history. Misbehavior slashes the bond, and a falcon-fast challenge can demand proof of unique hardware or prior work before any payout. Honest agents keep their opal-bright record; sybils pay for every fake face and gain nothing.
